question: What cosmic power arises from constant contemplation of a smoke-colored form?
premises: The practitioner contemplates a smoke-colored form always.
This contemplation produces a powerful effect.
The effect extends to the triple world.
inference: By always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one can shake the triple world.
uncertainties: The specific object visualized as smoke-colored is not named in this verse.
plain_english: O beloved, by always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one can shake the triple world.
